summary: StratCap Digital Infrastructure REIT filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that Chris Flynn resigned effective September 30, 2026 as Chief Investment Officer – Data Centers of the external advisor StratCap Digital Infrastructure Advisors II, LLC and of sponsor StratCap Investment Management, LLC, plus his sponsor investment committee seat. The filing states no disagreement with the company, advisor, or sponsor. Flynn signed a consulting agreement with affiliate StratCap, LLC running October 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027 for transaction advisory on specified assets. A non-executive advisor-level departure, not an abrupt registrant CEO/CFO event, so no special-situation category applies; watch asset-level execution continuity.
